say:0:1520318001:0.male: He's got the leaf. Time to <style="highlight">rendezvous</style>.
say:0:1520318001:0.female: He's got the leaf. Time to <style="highlight">rendezvous</style>.

say:1:1520319001:1.text: Look! I did it. I actually got a hornleaf bear's leaf!
say:1:1520319001:1.source_cn: 看！我成功拿到叶角熊的褪叶了！

say:5:1520319003:1.text: You should be thanking <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Without <male>him</male>, you wouldn't have gotten that leaf so easily.
say:5:1520319003:1.male: You should be thanking <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Without <male>him</male>, you wouldn't have gotten that leaf so easily.
say:5:1520319003:1.female: You should be thanking <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Without <female>her</female>, you wouldn't have gotten that leaf so easily.

say:7:1520319005:0.text: But let's move. We'd better <style="highlight">head back to Veilwatch Camp</style> before the bears realize what's missing!
say:7:1520319005:0.source_cn: 不过，趁着叶角熊还没反应过来，我们还是赶紧<style...

say:0:1520320001:0.text: Hey, I see Toro up ahead!
say:0:1520320001:0.source_cn: 我看到了！都罗就在前面！

say:1:1520321001:1.text: Toro! Look! I got a hornleaf bear's leaf!
say:1:1520321001:1.source_cn: 都罗，看！我拿到叶角熊的褪叶了！

say:2:1520321002:0.text: That fast? Let me see it.

say:3:1520321003:0.source_cn: 不错，果然是叶角熊的褪叶。

say:5:1520321004:0.text: Now that everything's ready, there's no excuse. <style="highlight">Head to the Primal Shrine and fix that roof</style>.
say:5:1520321004:0.source_cn: 既然材料已经准备齐全，你就尽快<style=highl...

say:6:1520321005:0.text: Wait, you were serious about fixing the roof?

say:7:1520321006:0.text: Of course I was. That's the task we gave you.
say:7:1520321006:0.source_cn: 当然，这才是你的主要任务。

say:8:1520321007:0.text: What, getting cold feet? Planning to run off halfway?
say:8:1520321007:0.source_cn: 怎么，又不敢了吗？想在路上偷偷逃跑？

say:9:1520321008:0.text: I-I'd never! I made up my mind. I will find my courage, whatever it takes!
say:9:1520321008:0.source_cn: 我、我才不会……！我已经下定决心要找到勇气了！

say:10:1520321009:0.text: I'm heading to the shrine right now!

say:12:1520321010:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've got one more request. Would you mind going with him?
say:12:1520321010:0.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've got one more request. Would you mind going with him?
say:12:1520321010:0.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've got one more request. Would you mind going with him?

say:13:1520321011:0.text: Hehe... I promise, what happens next will be worth seeing.
say:13:1520321011:0.source_cn: 呵呵……我可以向你保证，会出现很有趣的场景。
say:13:1520321011:0.male: Hehe... I promise, what happens next will be worth seeing.
say:13:1520321011:0.female: Hehe... I promise, what happens next will be worth seeing.

say:0:1520322001:0.text: Frui, get moving. No more delays!
say:0:1520322001:0.source_cn: 果，记得要尽快去神殿。尽快！

say:1:1520324001:1.text: T-that's a lot of hornleaf bears!!

say:2:1520324002:1.text: They must've figured out I took their leaf! Their noses are scary good!
say:2:1520324002:1.source_cn: 完了！它们一定是发现我偷走了它们的褪叶才追来的！它们鼻...

say:3:1520324003:1.text: No no no! This is bad!

say:4:1520324004:1.text: The shrine! I'll run for the shrine!

narration:5:1520324005:1.text: The hornleaf bears creep closer. Panicked, Frui scrambles up the shrine wall—arms flailing, feet slipping—and somehow manages to scale it in record time.
narration:5:1520324005:1.source_cn: 眼看叶角熊越逼越近，惊慌失措的果被吓得手脚并用，以惊人...

say:6:1520324006:0.text: Just as you spot him clinging to the rooftop, the hornleaf bears charge straight at you and Gala.
say:6:1520324006:0.source_cn: 你刚发现果爬上了屋顶，叶角熊却已经冲到了你和加拉面前。

say:1:1520325001:0.source_cn: 那些叶角熊……是不是都离开了？

say:8:1520325004:0.text: I thought I was done for! I didn't think, I just ran up the shrine as fast as I could...
say:8:1520325004:0.source_cn: 刚才真是吓死我了！吓得我只能往神殿屋顶上爬……

say:9:1520325005:1.text: And now that I'm up here, it actually feels kind of safe...
say:9:1520325005:1.source_cn: 果然还是待在野兽够不着的高处更有安全感啊……

choice_prompt:10:1520325005.text: And now that I'm up here, it actually feels kind of safe...
choice_prompt:10:1520325005.source_cn: 果然还是待在野兽够不着的高处更有安全感啊……

say:11:1520325006:1.text: Not gonna lie... the view up here's great too!
say:11:1520325006:1.source_cn: 哎，不得不说……高处的风景真不错啊！

choice:10:0:1.text: Seems like you found your courage.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 看来获得勇气的方法已经找到了
choice:10:0:1.male: Seems like you found your courage.
choice:10:0:1.female: Seems like you found your courage.

say:0:1520326001:0.text: Looks like I showed up late.

say:2:1520327002:1.text: Age is catching up with me. I'd hoped to reach you before the hornleaf bears did, to drive them off myself.
say:2:1520327002:1.source_cn: 果然是年纪大了……我原本还以为能赶在那些叶角熊之前过来...
say:2:1520327002:1.male: Age is catching up with me. I'd hoped to reach you before the hornleaf bears did, to drive them off myself.
say:2:1520327002:1.female: Age is catching up with me. I'd hoped to reach you before the hornleaf bears did, to drive them off myself.

choice_prompt:3:1520327002.text: Age is catching up with me. I'd hoped to reach you before the hornleaf bears did, to drive them off myself.
choice_prompt:3:1520327002.source_cn: 果然是年纪大了……我原本还以为能赶在那些叶角熊之前过来，替您驱赶它们。
choice_prompt:3:1520327002.male: Age is catching up with me. I'd hoped to reach you before the hornleaf bears did, to drive them off myself.
choice_prompt:3:1520327002.female: Age is catching up with me. I'd hoped to reach you before the hornleaf bears did, to drive them off myself.

say:4:1520327003:1.text: Hehe... Let's just call it my secret technique.
say:4:1520327003:1.source_cn: 呵呵……这是我秘不传人的诀窍。
say:4:1520327003:1.male: Hehe... Let's just call it my secret technique.
say:4:1520327003:1.female: Hehe... Let's just call it my secret technique.

say:5:1520327004:1.text: Frui, do you know why the Wildborn build their homes in the trees?
say:5:1520327004:1.source_cn: 果，你知道为何雅库伯尔人执着于将房屋建在树上吗？

say:8:1520327005:1.text: Uh... for the view? I mean, the view is pretty good!
say:8:1520327005:1.source_cn: 呃……为了看风景？这上面的风景不错！

say:14:1520327007:0.text: Oh, uh... So we don't get caught after stealing leaves from hornleaf bears?
say:14:1520327007:0.source_cn: 啊？那……那难道是为了偷叶子的时候不被叶角熊追上？

say:18:1520327009:0.text: We build our homes high to stay out of reach of wild beasts, and to gain the high ground when we do have to fight!
say:18:1520327009:0.source_cn: 把房屋建在高处，是为了躲避野兽的侵袭，还能帮我们在与野...

say:19:1520327010:0.text: That's why, in Wildborn tradition, you're not considered an adult until you've built your own treehouse.
say:19:1520327010:0.source_cn: 也是因此，雅库伯尔才会有“建造树屋后才算正式成年”的习俗。

say:20:1520327011:0.text: It's not just for you youngsters. Every Wildborn relies on the trees to survive. Understand?
say:20:1520327011:0.source_cn: 不仅是你们这些刚成年的孩子们，每一个雅库伯尔人都要依靠...

say:23:1520327012:1.text: I see! I get it now!
say:23:1520327012:1.source_cn: 原来是这样！我现在明白了！

say:26:1520327013:0.text: Sigh... Kids these days. They're too scared to even climb a tree. I just don't get it.
say:26:1520327013:0.source_cn: 唉……真是搞不明白，为什么新一代的孩子里，胆小的越来越...

say:27:1520327014:1.text: Alright, Frui. Come down already. This isn't a sightseeing trip.
say:27:1520327014:1.source_cn: 好了。果，快点下来，别在上面看风景了。

say:33:1520327016:1.text: What, you planning to live up there? Down. Now!
say:33:1520327016:1.source_cn: 难不成你要在上面呆一辈子？快点下来。

say:47:1520327022:0.text: W-wait! Toro, don't go! Toro, come back! Help!! HEEELP!!
say:47:1520327022:0.source_cn: 哎哎哎！都罗，你别走啊！都罗——！救命——！

choice:3:0:1.text: So it was your plan all along.
choice:3:0:1.male: So it was your plan all along.
choice:3:0:1.female: So it was your plan all along.

choice:3:1:2.text: So this is what you wanted me to see?
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 这就是你说的有趣的事？
choice:3:1:2.male: So this is what you wanted me to see?
choice:3:1:2.female: So this is what you wanted me to see?

say:1:1520315001:1.source_cn: 叶角熊的老巢就是这里……

say:2:1520315002:1.text: Looks like the whole pack's here...

say:5:1520315004:1.text: I've got one. We distract them with food. While they're busy eating, I sneak in, grab a leaf, and sneak out.
say:5:1520315004:1.source_cn: 我有一个计划：可以用食物引开这些叶角熊，再由我偷偷溜进...

say:7:1520315005:1.text: Only problem is, they eat fast, and I didn't bring much... It won't keep them busy for long.
say:7:1520315005:1.source_cn: 不过，叶角熊吃东西的速度很快，我带的食物又不多……恐怕...

say:8:1520315006:1.text: So this won't work unless someone helps. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:8:1520315006:1.source_cn: 所以，这个计划只凭我自己肯定没办法做到。<style=...
say:8:1520315006:1.male: So this won't work unless someone helps. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:8:1520315006:1.female: So this won't work unless someone helps. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>...

choice_prompt:9:1520315006.source_cn: 所以，这个计划只凭我自己肯定没办法做到。<style=stress><player_name></style>大人……
choice_prompt:9:1520315006.male: So this won't work unless someone helps. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
choice_prompt:9:1520315006.female: So this won't work unless someone helps. Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>...

say:11:1520315008:1.text: All we need is to find the right spot to drop the food. I promise, it'll be totally safe!
say:11:1520315008:1.source_cn: 只要找一个合适的地方放下食物就可以了，我保证没有任何危险！

say:19:1520315010:0.text: That spot right there looks perfect. Not too close, not too far. The scent will reach them for sure.
say:19:1520315010:0.source_cn: 那个位置就很好，距离那些叶角熊不近不远，食物的香气肯定...

say:21:1520315011:0.text: So we just <style="highlight">put the food down</style>, then <style="highlight">make a move to draw their attention</style>. Once they're distracted, we slip away before they even notice!

say:22:1520315012:0.text: I know hornleaf bears. The moment they catch a whiff of food, they forget everything else. Greedy things!
say:22:1520315012:0.source_cn: 我很了解这些叶角熊，它们最大的特点就是贪吃！

say:27:1520315013:0.text: While they're busy, I'll <style="highlight">climb down that vine</style>, grab the leaf, and come right back!
say:27:1520315013:0.source_cn: 等叶角熊被引开之后，我就<style=highligh...

say:29:1520315014:0.text: Climb down that vine? What about your fear of heights?

say:30:1520315015:0.text: W-well... that vine's against the wall. And I won't be up high for long. It's fine!
say:30:1520315015:0.source_cn: 那、那块藤蔓靠墙，我也不需要在高处待多长时间……肯定没问题。

say:31:1520315016:0.text: Huh... Now that I think about it, I've never been scared climbing vines before.
say:31:1520315016:0.source_cn: 说起来……为什么我以前爬藤蔓的时候没觉得恐高呢？

say:36:1520315017:0.text:
We meet back here when it's done.
Quick exit. No fuss!
say:36:1520315017:0.source_cn: 最后，我们就在这里汇合。\n迅速撤离，全身而退！

say:37:1520315018:0.text: So? Pretty solid plan, right? Simple and effective.
say:37:1520315018:0.source_cn: 怎么样？是不是一个又棒又简单的计划？

choice_prompt:38:1520315018.source_cn: 怎么样？是不是一个又棒又简单的计划？

say:39:1520315019:0.text: If I did it alone, it'd take forever. I'm just trying to fix the roof faster. That's all.
say:39:1520315019:0.source_cn: 一个人要花很长时间……我是为了尽快修好屋顶！嗯，就是这样。

narration:44:1502071503:0.text: In the end, Frui points to a safe place.
narration:44:1502071503:0.source_cn: 最后，果指了一个安全的地方。

choice:38:0:1.text: If only you could solo it.
choice:38:0:1.source_cn: 要是能一个人解决就更好了
choice:38:0:1.male: If only you could solo it.
choice:38:0:1.female: If only you could solo it.

say:45:1520315020:0.source_cn: 当然了，我可是逐影营地的战士！虽然爬高不行……但狩猎还...

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 好了别说了！我帮你就是了！
